03 / ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE CHECK

“IS OUR SITE UP
OVER THERE?”

A simple question. A useful first mission.

Companies can request checks of their own public websites from different regions, helping spot differences in availability and responses.

The pilot is scoped to approved public endpoints. No logins, private accounts, or open-ended traffic routing.

See a sample check request ↗
04 / CONSENT IS THE WHOLE POINT

YOUR WI-FI.
YOUR RULES.
NO WEIRD STUFF.

Useful doesn’t mean unrestricted.
Here’s what the product is designed to allow.

01

What uses my connection?

Small requests to approved public website destinations. AFKMAXX is not an unrestricted residential proxy service.

02

Can I pause it?

Yes. You control when checks run and can pause new checks. A daily data cap limits usage.

03

Can I see the destinations?

Yes. Review the approved destination list and check history. Checks must stay within your selected permissions.

04

What if there’s no work?

Then there’s nothing to run or earn. Work availability and income are never guaranteed.

05

Who verifies the results?

AFKMAXX must validate results before accepting work. Verification rules are still being finalized for the pilot; a successful response alone does not guarantee payment.

05 / FOLLOW THE RECORD

CHECKS OFFCHAIN.
RECORDS ONCHAIN.

Robinhood Chain is the intended layer for inspectable payout records and withdrawals for accepted work. It does not execute or prove website checks.

AFKMAXX is independent and is not endorsed by Robinhood. Integration, supported withdrawals, fees, and eligibility will be confirmed before the pilot opens.

01 / CHECK FUEL

Customers spend $AFK.

A company that wants “is our site up over there?” pays in $AFK to queue approved public checks. No $AFK, no extra lore. Just a paid request that still has to pass your limits.

02 / AFK PAY

Accepted work settles in $AFK.

When a result is reviewed and accepted, the intended payout unit is $AFK. Nothing is earned in this demo. Availability, fees, and acceptance rules will be published before the pilot.

03 / PRIORITY STAKE

Lock $AFK when work is scarce.

A proposed stake can raise eligibility for the next eligible check. Stake does not bypass destinations, data caps, or the off switch. It is not a yield promise.

04 / ONE LEDGER

Desktop and mobile share the bag.

$AFK is the same token in the desktop runtime and the phone app. Pause on one device, the permission story stays the same. The apps are demos; no live bag exists yet.

08 / THE ACTUAL QUESTIONS

LESS MYSTERY.
MORE SPECIFICS.

How much can I earn?+

There is no earnings estimate or guaranteed income. Payment depends on available work, acceptance, and the terms published before participation.

Does the app read my browsing history?+

The proposed checks do not need your browsing history, personal accounts, or page contents from your browsing. Exact permissions and data handling will be documented before installation is available.

Do I need a wallet?+

This demo needs no wallet. Wallet requirements and withdrawal options for the proposed Robinhood Chain integration will be specified before the pilot opens.

Can I join right now?+

Not yet. The pilot is not open and this website does not collect applications or email addresses.

What is $AFK?+

$AFK is the intended native token of AFKMAXX. It is designed to pay for check requests, settle accepted work, and optionally raise eligibility through a stake. The token is not live on this site and nothing here is an offer to buy or sell it.

Is $AFK launching on Robinhood?+

Robinhood is the intended first public market and Robinhood Chain is the intended record layer for payouts. A listing is not confirmed, not live, and not endorsed by Robinhood. If and when a market exists, AFKMAXX will say so in plain language.

Does holding $AFK make me money while AFK?+

No. Holding the token is not a job and is not an earnings estimate. Payment, if any, depends on available work, acceptance, and published terms. Token price can go to zero. This is not financial advice.

Can I run checks from the web?+

The dashboard runs in the browser. Actual HTTPS checks need the AFKMAXX extension, because a normal webpage cannot read other sites’ responses. Open the web app, load the unpacked extension, approve destinations, then start. Results are unaudited and are not payouts.
